verdict.rationale: Kong exposes a RESTful Admin API on :8001 for configuring routing, load balancing, health checks and other gateway entities. Kong's docs also publish a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its APIs, and decK and kongctl provide tooling on top. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the Admin API, and the OpenAPI specs are not served at standard discovery paths (the probe got 404s), so programmatic discovery takes extra steps.
